svg.title: ISER-MoE in one MoE layer
svg.desc: (a) Per-layer schedule on one rank: a high-priority COPY stream runs the HALO-Q scheduler and the in-switch weight replication beside the shared expert, and only MegaMoE's helper tiles wait at the READY gate; (b) HALO-Q's two objectives, balance and locality; (c) SAMI, multi-port in-switch broadcast in two pipelined steps; (d) the original 16/8/4-rank reference levels; PR #21373 adds aligned pairs, illustrated separately in Figure 12.
